title: Preparation of a Ni–ascorbic acid MOF as a recyclable catalyst for the synthesis of sulfoxides and tetrazoles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15748-15762
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00355E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mostafa Koolivand, Zahra Moradi, Mohsen Nikoorazm, Arash Ghorbani-Choghamarani
This study introduces a novel, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly approach for synthesizing a heterogeneous Ni–ascorbic acid metal–organic framework (Ni–ascorbic acid MOF) catalyst via a hydrothermal method.
